question: ______ covers most of the Deccan Plateau. which includes parts of Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat and Andhra Pradesh and some parts of Tamil Nadu.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Black soil.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Black soil is also known as **Regur soil or cotton soil.**
 
• It is rich in iron, lime, calcium, potassium, aluminum, and magnesium.
 
• This soil is highly **moisture-retentive **and becomes sticky when wet.
 
• It is ideal for growing cotton, which is why it is also called cotton soil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Peaty soil **founds in areas with **high rainfall and high humidity, rich in organic matter.**

**Laterite soil** founds in areas with high temperature and heavy rainfall, rich in iron and aluminum.

**Alluvial soil** founds in river basins, very fertile, and ideal for agriculture.

 [IMAGE: https://www.mapsofindia.com/maps/india/india-map-of-soils.jpg]
